name: y2kChrome
title: Y2K Chrome
description: Liquid mercury chrome textures, iridescent lilac and sky blue refractions, bubble geometry, chromatic dispersion, and playful elastic bounce.
do: Reflect prismatic pastel gradients across liquid metallic 3D extrusions
Add 4-point star glints and optical dispersals along specular highlights
Inject snappy overshoot and subtle elastic spring settling to layer entrances
dont: Do not render flat, dry, matte surfaces devoid of gloss and reflection
Avoid somber, dull, desaturated earth tones or heavy grunge
Never use rigid linear motion curves without playful overshoot
